commit.message:
Add validated VIC checkerboard decoder; rule out checkerboard for STR_A/STR_B

- solver/checkerboard.py: straddling-checkerboard/VIC decoder. Reproduces the
  Phase 3.2 VIC exactly -- alphabet fubcdora/lethingkymvpszjqwx., prefix digits
  (1,4) = the hint 'one for one, four for one' -> 'incaseyoumanagetocrack...'.
  Wired into the toolkit selftest (now 11 checks, all green).
- Applied the exact validated convention to STR_A/STR_B with prime prefixes
  {2,3,5,7}: negative across all prefix pairs, both digit mappings, and reversal.
  The earlier 'half/four for' fragments were artifacts of a wrong 9-column board.
- Conclusion recorded: if STR_A/STR_B are VIC, they use an unknown keyed alphabet
  (no crib yet). Docs updated with the result and sharpened next directions.

commit.message:
BREAKTHROUGH: faed (STR_B) is a Bifid cipher keyed by dbbi -> decodes to 'btcseed'

solver/bifid.py: verified crack of the 7-year dbbi/faed wall.
- dbbi (STR_A) unique letters in order = 'dbifhceg' (dropping the 9th, 'a' = the
  'character to be zeroed out'). This is the Bifid key.
- Bifid-decoding faed (STR_B) over a 5x5 square keyed 'dbifhceg' yields the
  literal word 'btcseed' + two new z-separated strings -> proves correctness.
- matrixsumlist (between dbbi/faed) = the instruction: Bifid is a matrix cipher.
- Reproduces the community CyberChef recipe. part1/part2 decode still in progress.
